license.summary: Bodies, faces, clothes, hair, eyes and skins are MakeHuman/MPFB system assets released CC0-1.0 (each source .mhclo/.mhmat header carries the CC0 declaration and was checked at build time). Garment, hair-cap and brow textures are ImageGen edits of those CC0 textures; prompts and input/output hashes are in each source manifest. No third-party character model is redistributed.

sourceJsonPaths: Tracked JSON beside the sources writes $CIVILIAN_STAGE, $REPO and ~ for machine paths; every sha256 in them refers to the unmodified off-repo original.

authorization.decision: Replace the clay figurine player AND crowd with the dressed civilian bodies in production; keep clay only as a load-failure fallback.
authorization.scope: Runtime GLBs under public/assets/characters/civilian-v1 only; sources stay in the off-repo asset store.

authorization.decision: Add two police families reserved for officers, so armed officers wear a uniform instead of civilian clothes.
